In the morning, I wake up with delight,
To hear his songs that make me laugh so bright.
His quirky lyrics and his unique style,
Philippe Katerine, you’re magic all the while.
I adore Philippe Katerine, it’s true,
But not all the time, I need something new.
His craziness makes me laugh, that’s for sure,
But sometimes, I crave different tunes to endure.
In my car, I turn on the radio,
His voice comes on, and again, I laugh so.
But sometimes, I want to sing something new,
To let myself be carried by different views.
I adore Philippe Katerine, it’s true,
But not all the time, I need something new.
His craziness makes me laugh, that’s for sure,
But sometimes, I crave different tunes to endure.
[ solo ]
Philippe, you’re unique, that’s clear and bright,
But sometimes, I yearn for a change of light.
Other artists, other melodies to sway,
To surprise me and make me feel that way.
[outro]
